name: apple-design
title_zh: 把苹果界面动效哲学转译成可落地的 Web 设计规范
tagline_zh: 做手势、弹簧动画、拖拽抽屉总差口气？这套 skill 把 iOS 的物理感、材质层次和排版细节拆给你。
tagline_en: Web gestures and springs feel off? This skill distills iOS physics, translucency, and typography into web-ready.
desc_en: Apple's approach to interface design and fluid, physical motion, translated for the web. Use when building or reviewing gesture-driven UI, spring animations, drag/swipe/sheet interactions, momentum and interruptible transitions, translucent materials and depth, typography (optical sizing, tracking, leading), reduced-motion, or the design foundations (feedback, spatial consistency, restraint) behin
why_zh: 不是贴苹果皮，而是提炼其动效底层逻辑：可中断曲线、动量守恒、景深材质，直接映射到 CSS 和 JS 参。
why_en: Not skin-deep mimicry—it extracts Apple's motion logic (interruptible curves, momentum, depth) into concrete CSS/JS parameters.
limit_zh: 只覆盖交互设计与视觉规范，不产出代码组件；需你自行实现动画逻辑。且仅适用于 Web 前端，不涉及 iOS 原生开发或设。
limit_en: Covers design principles only—no code components; you implement animations. Web-frontend only, not for native iOS or design-tool plugins.
